title: Checked ID List
prompt: A React checkbox group stores selected ids. Write a helper that adds the id when checked is true and removes the id when checked is false, without returning duplicates.

explanation.beginner:
Example: checkedIdList(["a"], "b", true) produces ["a","b"]. Evaluate the selection rule for every record and preserve the qualifying values in the required order.

Compare “removes unchecked ids”: input [["a","b"],"a",false] produces ["b"]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
Evaluate the selection rule for every record and preserve the qualifying values in the required order.

Tempting mistake: Selecting a display position after a list changes can identify the wrong item. Use the domain key when matching two collections.

The reference uses includes, filter. Trace the intermediate value after each operation; count repeated scans inside callbacks separately when estimating cost.

Regression check: preserve the contract illustrated by “removes unchecked ids”, then change one boundary in a new test. The solution below is one implementation; another is valid when it preserves the same behavior.
